evidence_limits: No suite was re-run; the reviewed run's baseline and head logs were read.
Both suite arms ran on all_debug rather than the rigel the section's done-when names.
The recorded negative-control.log reddens test_a_temp_directory_the_job_node_cannot_supply_is_named, not the temp-directory test the declared negative control names.

findings.text: blocking: _recipe injects temp_overlay itself and no test composes a recipe through fence_argv, so deleting the emission at reckon/_worker_fence.py:2225 changes no test outcome and the production half of the change has no guard.

non-blocking: NEGATIVE_CONTROL_MUTATION removes the source check rather than restoring the temp bind to its base form, so negative-control.log records test_the_tasks_own_temp_directory_stands_in_and_the_task_runs passing and only test_a_temp_directory_the_job_node_cannot_supply_is_named failing, and the node's declared negative control is not the one shown.

non-blocking: the fragment quotes the refusal as "absent on this node and not the task's temp directory", a wording commit b3232aa051 deleted, where reckon/nested_launch.py:665 now says "absent on this node, so the task was not started and the fence was not dropped".
non-blocking: the fragment records both suite arms on all_debug while the section's done-when requires each arm run on rigel, and no record states why the partition changed.

non-blocking: the comment claims every source the inherited fence mounts is checked, but the scan at :649 covers only --bind, --dev-bind, --bind-try and --dev-bind-try, so an absent --ro-bind source still reaches bubblewrap whose message names no node, and the deliverable's "message naming the path and the node it ran on" does not hold for seals.
non-blocking: the grant option tuple duplicates the prepare block's grants tuple at :599, so a grant form added to one scan is silently unchecked by the other.
